    fixture = tmp_path / INVENTORY_GUARD_HARNESS_FIXTURE
    guard = tmp_path / "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
    if mutation in {"fixture", "coordinated"}:
        fixture.write_bytes(fixture.read_bytes() + b"\n")
    if mutation in {"slot", "coordinated"}:
        digest = (
            hashlib.sha256(fixture.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            if mutation == "coordinated"
            else "f" * 64
        )
        old = INVENTORY_GUARD_HARNESS_SHA256.encode()
        data = guard.read_bytes()
        assert data.count(old) == 1
        guard.write_bytes(data.replace(old, digest.encode()))
    if mutation in {"helper", "coordinated"}:
        data = guard.read_bytes()
        marker = b"def inventory_guard_harness_originals(root):\n"
        assert data.count(marker) == 1
        guard.write_bytes(
            data.replace(marker, marker + b'    raise RuntimeError("copied code executed")\n')
        )
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        inventory_guard_harness_originals(tmp_path)
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):

    elif mutation == "extra_key":

    elif mutation == "missing_path":

    elif mutation in {"original_hash", "reviewed_hash"}:
        entry[mutation.replace("_hash", "_sha256")] = "f" * 64
    elif mutation in {"original_length", "reviewed_length"}:
        entry[mutation.replace("_length", "_bytes")] += 1
    elif mutation in {"original_length_bool", "reviewed_length_bool"}:
        entry[mutation.replace("_length_bool", "_bytes")] = True
    elif mutation == "reviewed_length_negative":
        entry["reviewed_bytes"] = -1
    elif mutation == "entry_key":
        entry["skip"] = True
    elif mutation == "hunk_key":
        hunk["skip"] = True
    elif mutation == "empty_hunks":
        entry["hunks"] = []
    elif mutation == "start_negative":
        hunk["new_start"] = -1
    elif mutation == "start_bool":
        hunk["new_start"] = False
    elif mutation == "start_overflow":
        hunk["new_start"] = entry["reviewed_bytes"] + 1
    elif mutation == "end_bool":
        hunk["new_end"] = True
    elif mutation == "end_negative":

    elif mutation == "end_before_start":
        hunk["new_end"] = hunk["new_start"] - 1
    elif mutation == "end_overflow":

    elif mutation in {"replacement", "original"}:
        hunk[mutation] += "# unreviewed\n"
    elif mutation == "duplicate_hunk":
        entry["hunks"].insert(1, dict(hunk))
    elif mutation == "overlapping_hunks":
